proposed_rules.trigger: A [presentation] container with N uniform ~60px rows sits under a non-FAQ heading (e.g. 'More About Knack's Security Features'), matching the structural signature of the confirmed faq-accordion-block rule but not literally an FAQ.
proposed_rules.decision: Extend faq-accordion-block's mapping (one accordion block, one row per item) to any uniform-row presentation list regardless of the heading wording.
proposed_rules.rationale: The structural DNA (uniform row height, [presentation] role, expandable-looking single-line items) is what defines the accordion, not the specific 'FAQ' label; rejected alternative is treating each row as a separate plain link list with no block.
